description: Founderhood is a journey of invisible battles—sleepless nights, isolated decisions, and pressures that rarely fit into pitch decks. Here, early-stage founders gather not to exchange LinkedIn connections, but to share openly with peers who understand the unspoken weight of building something meaningful.

name: Sonder Literary Salon
address: 1951 Telegraph Ave Suite 4, Oakland, CA 94612, USA
description: Sonder Literary Salon is a conceptual poetry experience that pays homage to the sacred spaces where conversation and community are the connective tissue that bind us. For our second installment we are taking it to Church. We will be hosting a conversation with Cole Arthur Riley, NY times best selling author of Black Liturgies and This Here Flesh. We will be exploring the joy, the healing, the trauma, and the transformation church and spirituality have had in the lives of BIPOC folks, especially for the queer and trans community. This will be an immersive and interactive experience that will allow you to connect with your community, your roots, your memories, and yourself in a deep and intentional way. This is not just a poetry reading, but a chance to dive deep and emerge transformed. $35 Per Person General Admission Attire: Your Sunday best.
